# Double Diffusion

> An AI-powered creative and production studio. We combine on-set cinematography
> with generative AI post-production to deliver commercials, social content,
> music videos, and narrative work.

Contact: creative@doublediffusion.co
Book a demo: https://www.doublediffusion.co/demo

## Services

- [Creative Production](https://www.doublediffusion.co/services/creative-production): End-to-end ad and campaign production, concept to final cut. Typical timeline 1–2 weeks.
- [AI Production Assessment](https://www.doublediffusion.co/services/ai-evaluation): We evaluate a creative brief scene by scene to identify where generative tools can replace traditional methods, and return a cost breakdown and production roadmap. Typical timeline 2–3 days.
- [Social Content](https://www.doublediffusion.co/services/social-content): Vertical video for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, including UGC-style content and product demos. Typical timeline 3–5 days.
- [Music Videos](https://www.doublediffusion.co/services/music-videos): Concept, storyboarding, VFX, color, and final delivery. Typical timeline 1–3 weeks.
- [Narrative Production](https://www.doublediffusion.co/services/narrative-production): Hybrid live-action and AI production for short films, branded narratives, and feature-length projects. Typical timeline 2–6 weeks.
